role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 巫医可以为团队提供所需的一切。持续的治疗、眩晕和诅咒保证了团队每个人头，强大的终极技能则让他自己在舞蹈中毁灭敌人，他技能的全面实在是少有匹敌。
hero_summary_en: Witch Doctor is whatever his team needs him to be. Whether aiding his team with gradual healing, stunning and cursing foes to ensure a kill, or destroying enemies himself with a dance by his mighty ultimate, few can match Witch Doctor's versatility.

abilities.name: witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask
abilities.description_zh: 抛出一个装满麻痹粉末的药剂，在敌方单位之间弹跳，眩晕击中的敌人并造成伤害。每次弹跳都会提升伤害。
abilities.description_en: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.
notes_zh: 目标可以受到多次作用，只要附近有其他单位可以进行弹跳。
notes_en: Targets can be hit multiple times, as long as another unit is struck in between the bounces.
facet_text_en: Paralyzing Cask deals more damage each bounce.
facet_text_zh: 麻痹药剂每次弹跳造成额外伤害。

abilities.name: witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration
abilities.description_zh: 巫医集中魔力治疗附近的友军单位，开启巫毒疗法后会持续消耗巫医的魔法。
abilities.description_en: Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.
notes_en: Healing is done in %heal_interval% second intervals.
facet_text_en: Voodoo Restoration deals damage to enemies and only heals Witch Doctor.
facet_text_zh: 巫毒疗法对敌人造成伤害，只会治疗巫医自身。

abilities.name: witch_doctor_maledict
abilities.description_zh: 对一个较小区域内所有敌方英雄和玩家控制的目标施放诅咒，他们将每秒受到固定伤害，并且从诅咒开始每4秒根据失去的血量再受到爆发伤害。
abilities.description_en: Curses all enemy Heroes and player-controlled targets in a small area, causing them to take a set amount of damage each second, as well as bursts of damage every 4 seconds based on how much health they have lost since the curse began.
notes_zh: 受到作用的英雄如果在结算时当前血量高于原血量，则额外伤害为0。
notes_en: If an affected hero's health has increased above the amount they had when Maledict was cast, the burst damage will be 0.
facet_text_en: Enemies who die while cursed deal damage equal to %spread_pct%%% of what the next burst damage would be to all enemy units in a %spread_radius% radius.
facet_text_zh: 被诅咒的敌人阵亡后会对%spread_radius%范围内所有敌方单位造成伤害，数值等于下次爆发伤害的%spread_pct%%%。

abilities.name: witch_doctor_voodoo_switcheroo
abilities.description_zh: 巫医暂时变成死亡守卫，死亡守卫的攻击速度有所降低。这段时间内自己为隐藏状态。
abilities.description_en: Turns Witch Doctor into a Death Ward briefly with reduced attack speed. He is hidden during this time.

abilities.name: witch_doctor_gris_gris
abilities.description_zh: 巫医获得了驱邪护符，这件物品无法丢弃或放在背包里。拥有者阵亡时，死亡损失金钱的%death_gold_lost_reduction_pct_tooltip%%%会加入到该物品中，物品被消耗后将退回这些金钱。驱邪护符的价值每%gold_tick_interval_tooltip%秒会增加1金。右键点击可以消耗这件物品，并将其永久移除。
abilities.description_en: Witch Doctor gets a Gris-Gris, an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. When the owner dies, %death_gold_lost_reduction_pct_tooltip%%% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. The value of the Gris-Gris is increased by 1 every %gold_tick_interval_tooltip%s.  Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.

abilities.name: witch_doctor_death_ward
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 召唤一个死亡守卫，会优先攻击其攻击距离内的敌方英雄。最多持续%abilitychanneltime%秒。死亡守卫拥有%bonus_accuracy%%%额外必中率。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Death Ward has %bonus_accuracy%%% bonus accuracy.
notes_zh: 死亡守卫是无敌的，只有在巫医被打断或持续时间结束后才会被摧毁。
死亡守卫可以受到控制，选择攻击特定目标。
死亡守卫每0.22秒攻击一次。
notes_en: The Death Ward is invulnerable, and is only destroyed if Witch Doctor is interrupted or its duration expires.
The Death Ward can be controlled, and made to attack a specific target.
Death Ward attacks once every 0.22 seconds.

scepter_loc.en: Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.
scepter_loc.zh: 死亡守卫的攻击会向附近英雄弹射。

facet_text_en: Death Ward attacks %initial_target_count% targets at once with reduced damage. The secondary target takes %secondary_attack_damage_pct%%% of the damage.
facet_text_zh: 死亡守卫同时攻击%initial_target_count%个目标，但伤害降低。次级目标受到%secondary_attack_damage_pct%%%伤害。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_witch_doctor_maledict_spread
talents_raw.name_loc: Maledict bursts deal {s:bonus_spread_pct}% damage in a {s:bonus_spread_radius} AoE
talents_raw.desc_loc: Sends projectiles that deal {s:bonus_spread_pct}% of the burst damage at all enemy units within {s:bonus_spread_radius} range

talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_bonus_heal_percent}% Target Max Health Voodoo Restoration Heal
